title: Idea
description: One tracked idea, at any stage from raw thought to shipped. One file per idea in ideas/entries/. See ideas/README.md for the workflow this supports.

status.description: new = captured, not yet reviewed. wishlist = reviewed and liked, intentionally not prioritized yet. accepted = we're doing this, even if how isn't designed yet. in-progress = actively being built. done = shipped (see resolution for what/where). rejected = explicitly decided against (see resolution for why) — kept so it doesn't get re-proposed from scratch.

domains.description: Free-text tags for filtering, e.g. narrative, mechanics, tooling, audio, ui, technical-architecture, worldbuilding. An idea can span several.

summary.description: One line — what this is, at a glance.

description.description: The full capture. Long-form is fine; faithfulness to what was actually said matters more than brevity here.

lastTouchedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, updated whenever status changes or the idea is meaningfully discussed again. This is what a staleness review compares against — see ideas/README.md.

sourceContext.description: Brief provenance note — where/when this came from, so it's traceable without digging through conversation history.

openSubQuestions.description: Things about THIS idea that are still undecided. Lighter-weight than data/campaign/open-questions.json, which is for bigger campaign-design questions — use that instead if a sub-question outgrows this idea.

resolvedSubQuestions.description: Sub-questions that HAVE been answered, kept with their answers rather than deleted — an idea often gets partially settled long before its overall status changes, and losing the reasoning behind an answered question means re-litigating it later. Move entries here out of openSubQuestions when the user actually decides; include the decision and the date.

relatedRefs.description: Cross-links: other idea ids, design docs, schema/data files.

resolution.description: For done: what was actually built and where. For rejected: why. For accepted/in-progress: optional refining notes.
